# Field Theory runtime notices

Karakeep Transfer bundles these components for X-source discovery and
acquisition. The generated desktop resources retain the license files shipped
by every package.

| Component | Pinned version | License | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Field Theory CLI | 1.3.22 at `4b4a0f677e7077ac76848408b22091fc34330391` | MIT | <https://github.com/afar1/fieldtheory-cli> |
| Node.js | 26.13.1 | MIT and bundled third-party notices | <https://nodejs.org/dist/v26.13.1/> |
| SQLite `sqlite3.exe` (Windows x64 only) | 3.53.4 | Public Domain | <https://www.sqlite.org/2026/sqlite-tools-win-x64-3530400.zip> |
| commander | 14.0.3 | MIT | <https://www.npmjs.com/package/commander> |
| dotenv | 17.4.2 | BSD-2-Clause | <https://www.npmjs.com/package/dotenv> |
| sql.js | 1.14.1 | MIT | <https://www.npmjs.com/package/sql.js> |
| sql.js-fts5 | 1.4.0 | MIT | <https://www.npmjs.com/package/sql.js-fts5> |
| undici | 6.29.1 | MIT | <https://www.npmjs.com/package/undici> |

The authoritative artifact checksums are in
[`manifest.json`](./manifest.json). Field Theory's complete MIT text is in
[`LICENSE`](./LICENSE); Node and npm dependency license texts are copied into
the prepared resource tree used by the local desktop build. SQLite is released
into the public domain under its
[official copyright notice](https://www.sqlite.org/copyright.html).
